summary: Syntax is inside the profile (no restricted construction; the one parser flag is a false positive) and the version has the most idiomatic Dutch of the three ('Dat meen je niet', 'Ik ben niet altijd zo geweest'). Its cost is idiom made of known tokens that the checker cannot see: 'maar al te bang' is opaque to the reader and must go; 'thuis zijn in', the bare 'Ik heb ze gezegd' and the als/dan hypothetical in b022 should be plainer.

findings.fragment: hij was maar al te bang
findings.problem: The idiom 'maar al te' (only too) is not in the lexicon; every token is known, so the reader parses it as but + already + too and loses the sentence.
findings.evidence: lexicon: no phrase 'maar al te'; vocab check passed it as 100% known tokens; plain equivalent exists
findings.required_fix: hij was heel bang. (or: hij was echt bang.)

findings.fragment: je bent niet thuis in de sceptische literatuur
findings.problem: Idiom 'thuis zijn in' (to be well-versed in) is not in the lexicon; decodable through the English parallel 'at home in', but a stumble for the profile reader when a plain verb exists.
findings.evidence: lexicon: thuis known A1 only as 'at home'; no phrase 'thuis zijn in'
findings.required_fix: je kent de sceptische literatuur niet.

findings.fragment: Ik heb ze gezegd: jij mocht het niet weten,
findings.problem: 'ze' as a bare indirect object of 'zeggen' without 'tegen' is colloquial/regional; a reader who knows 'ze' as subject/object reads 'I have said them'.
findings.evidence: naturalness; standard Dutch is 'tegen ze zeggen' / 'hun zeggen'
findings.required_fix: Ik heb tegen ze gezegd: jij mocht het niet weten,

findings.fragment: Als ik dan niet haar magie kon hebben, dan kon ik tenminste mooi zijn.
findings.problem: Legal (A-SUB-FIRST + A-SUB-2V) but the heaviest sentence of the scene: a hypothetical als-clause, two modal clusters (kon hebben, kon … zijn), a doubled 'dan', and contrastive 'niet haar magie' word order.
findings.evidence: L-SUB/L-VERBS not exceeded; stacked allowed constructions in one 15-word sentence
findings.required_fix: Haar magie kon ik niet krijgen, maar ik kon tenminste mooi zijn.

findings.fragment: maar \gl{hield voet bij stuk}{stood her ground}
findings.problem: B1 idiom (lexicon phrase 'voet bij stuk' stretch) kept for voice and glossed.
findings.evidence: lexicon phrases: voet bij stuk stretch B1; glossed, so outside the unglossed budget
findings.required_fix: No change. Plain fallback if a gloss must go: 'maar ze hield vol' / 'maar ze bleef bij haar woorden'.

findings.problem: Figurative use of 'verraden' (to give away) where the reader knows it as 'to betray'.
findings.evidence: lexicon: verraden known A2 'to betray'; English uses the same figure ('his tone betrayed him')
findings.required_fix: No change required; plain alternative 'Zijn toon zei iets anders:' if the meaning reviewer finds it too literary.

findings.problem: 'leren' + object + bare infinitive is an accusative-with-infinitive like zien/horen (R-PERCEPTION) but is not listed in restricted.md.

findings.required_fix: No change; accepted as the plainest option. Profile owner: decide whether 'leren + obj + inf' is allowed or restricted.

flag_decisions.reason: Attributive adjectival participle used as a plain adjective (dep amod, no complements); restricted.md: simple adjectival participles that behave as adjectives are fine; base verb 'trainen' is known A1.

tool_feedback.reason: Bare attributive participle with dep amod and no children is an adjective, not a participle phrase; suppress amod participles without complements.
